title: A large refactor is a Migration Change
context: Split out of ADR-0045. A refactor too large for the size targets still needs one approved overall plan.
decision: A large refactor is a Migration Change: its Proposal passes G1 once with the shard list, order and completion criteria, and each shard is its own Change that carries a Migration trailer, references the Migration Proposal's slug and passes only G2. The Migration's decision record is written once, when the migration is decided.
consequences: A Migration trailer suppresses the src-file-count warning for its shards.
